result.brief: 提出粒子-体素混合自编码器将点云压缩为紧凑3D体素潜变量，并用动作条件潜动力学模型预测其演化，实现外观、几何与触觉的多模态3D世界模拟。
result.reason: Action-conditioned 3D world model with hybrid particle-voxel autoencoder producing compact 3D voxel latents and latent dynamics; contributes representation plus world modeling, though applied to robot planning.
